connector.name: Watch Cli
connector.registryDescription: Hand any social video to your AI agent - frames + transcript bundled. MCP server for watch-cli.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package watch-cli-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sonpiaz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KYMA_API_KEY
env.description: Kyma API key (default backend). Get one at https://kymaapi.com — first $0.50 free, then pay-per-use (~$0.05 per 1-hour video). Optional if WATCH_AUDIO_MODE=local (whisper.cpp) or GROQ_API_KEY is set instead.

env.name: GROQ_API_KEY
env.description: Groq API key for direct BYOK transcription (alternative to Kyma). Set this instead of KYMA_API_KEY if you prefer direct provider.

env.name: WATCH_AUDIO_MODE
env.description: Backend routing override. Values: kyma (default), byok (use GROQ_API_KEY), local (whisper.cpp on $PATH, fully offline).
